basis: Sequential gzip-table reader over 6,000,510 already validated coordinate/ORF rows. It retains per-taxon gap vectors only, so memory is bounded by the largest individual taxon's table; the final TSV has 526 rows.
scope: Full-panel source-bound coordinate-order context summary. It does not discover repeats, synteny, rearrangement, duplication, orthology or structural-evolution effects.
